answer: Each identity locks 750 POA as a comet bond that thaws only after eight clean epochs. Every epoch, three established peers float a 64-byte nonce down a 30-second river: the bonded key must sign it and return a live bandwidth proof before the nonce expires, so one host cannot precompute a farm of replies. Failures, reused nonces, or a shared hardware root exile that key to an isolation island, slashing half the bond and ignoring its attestations for five epochs. Standing up n sybils costs 750n POA plus n real-time responders.
